Name: Confirm admin roles and org basics
Description: Confirm admin/super admin roles. Set company name, logo, security email, authenticated domains, fiscal year. Done when: org settings saved.

Name: Document current state
Description: Pull membership, guest, and integration reports from the Admin console. Done when: baseline saved.

Name: Run license audit
Description: Identify inactive and non-contributing users; review team projects before deleting any team. Done when: removal/downgrade list approved.

Name: Convert stakeholders to view only licenses
Description: Update licenses as needed. Done when: no stakeholder holds a full license unnecessarily.

Name: Document license change-request approval rule
Description: Define who approves license changes and how fast. Done when: rule documented.

Name: Configure guest invite settings and trusted guest domains
Description: Admin console > Settings. Done when: only trusted domains can be invited.

Name: Set project and team privacy defaults
Description: Define project privacy defaults and team privacy settings. Done when: defaults match least-privilege policy.

Name: Review RAC roles and create custom roles
Description: Admin console > Manage roles. Done when: roles match actual job functions.

Name: Enable work access mode for sensitive projects
Description: Admin console > Launch Asana > Work access mode; extend session length if needed. Done when: enabled and tested.

Name: Write deprovisioning procedure and offboard stale guests
Description: Members tab > three-dot menu > Remove; create a private-to-members project for the removed member's tasks and reassign. Done when: stale guests removed.

Name: Review integrations and set app approvals
Description: Check app details; set approvals; update blocked/allowed apps. Done when: all active apps are approved or blocked.

Name: Set up service accounts and PAT security policy
Description: Move automations to service accounts; set Personal Access Token policy. Done when: no automation depends on a personal token.

Name: Review Asana AI and AI Studio settings
Description: Confirm providers, web access, plan, member access, and credit usage. Done when: settings documented.

Name: Complete security checkup and breach response plan
Description: Access review; authentication; configuration; data protection; patching; documentation. Finalize docs/06 runbook. Done when: checkup report and plan saved.

Name: Build Insights dashboard
Description: Track teams created, invites sent, projects shared, engagement over time. Done when: dashboard shared.

Name: Finalize governance and data-retention checklist
Description: Cover access, data security, invite permissions, compliance, monitoring, policy updates, retention. Done when: checklist published.

Name: Verify full checklist and collect feedback
Description: Walk the 7-item checklist end to end. Done when: gaps logged and fixed.

Name: Quarterly governance and security review (recurring)
Description: Use templates/quarterly-governance-review.md. Set task to repeat every 3 months.
